content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to create a new task with a title, description, priority and due date","so_that":"I can record work I need to do, with its deadline, on my personal task list","business_description":"Users need to record the work they have to do. This story lets a user create a task with a mandatory Title, a Description, a Priority (Low, Medium or High) and a Due Date. The backend saves each task with a unique ID, a Creation Date, Status Open and a Last Updated Date. The backend rejects tasks with an empty Title or a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date. The frontend shows success only after the backend confirms the save.","business_value":"A saved task list gives the user one place to record work and its deadline. the entered Title, Description, Priority and Due Date, and the form shows the message 'Task created'"},{"given":"The task creation form is open with an empty Title","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the request, no task is saved, and the form shows an error message stating that the title is required"},{"given":"A new task with a Creation Date of 2025-06-10","when":"The user submits a Due Date of 2025-06-09","then":"The backend rejects the task, nothing is saved, and the form shows an error message stating that the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date"},{"given":"A new task with a Creation Date of 2025-06-10","when":"The user submits a Due Date of 2025-06-10","then":"The backend saves the task and the form shows the message
